accounting_rules: Do not treat planning envelope as spent.
Separate land, CIP, building, critical plant, IT hardware, colo OPEX and labor.
Do not book incentives before evidenced approval.
Do not double count existing facilities/vendor allowances without supported displacement.
Fractional workload FTE are allocations, not automatic new hires.
